apps.name: Dopamine
apps.subtitle: Rootless jailbreak, iOS 15-26.0.1
apps.localizedDescription: A rootless, semi-untethered jailbreak for supported iPhones and iPads. Device and firmware support varies by chip generation and release. Check the upstream compatibility notes for your exact model and iOS build.

versions.localizedDescription:
FIx a bug in posix_spawn hook where changes to the passed attribute structure would persist after the function returned, causing unwanted behavior to happen when the caller reuses the same attribute structure for another call (In practice this fixes Zebra not working properly on iOS 17.6+)
Improve logic that redirects SpringBoard snapshots in rootlesshook (Contributed by @verygenericname)

Add workaround for stock issue that causes touch not to work on certain A10/A11 aftermarket screens after a userspace reboot (Contributed by @moezemara)
Fix some system preference plists being redirected to /var/jb in rootlesshook (Contributed by @verygenericname)

Fix support for iOS 26.0 beta 1 [3.0.1 regression]
Fix boot logo not being cleaned up correctly before backboardd starts, fixes framebuffer getting stuck with it's last content during sbreload when a boot logo is used (now the screen will correctly fade to a black screen like when no boot logo is used)
Update opainject and litehook

Expose an API to frida that allows it to hook memory over hookd, fixes panics when using frida on iOS 26+ (Requires frida >=17.19.0) (contributed by @devnoname120)
Fix Xcode debugging being broken on iOS 17+ after a userspace reboot if a developer disk image was already mounted before the userspace reboot
Fix jailbreak apps not being removed from home screen when removing the jailbreak on iOS 18.0 - 18.3.1 too

Fix jailbreak apps not being removed from home screen when removing the jailbreak on iOS 18.4+
Remove "Remove Jailbreak" button from settings when the device is jailbroken since it was too unstable, it will now only show up when not jailbroken on TrollStore installations, the only supported uninstallation flow on non TrollStore installations is now to reboot and rejailbreak with the "Remove Jailbreak" toggle enabled
Fix "Hide Jailbreak" explanation not showing up in app settings [2.5 beta regression]
Improve "Hide Jailbreak" explanation in app settings to cause less confusion about what it does and emphasize the fact the user should only use it on their own risk

Fix an OOB kernel write during the jbupdate process that could cause a panic and in some cases leave the file /var/jb/basebin/gen/dyld.old in a corrupted state where it cannot be deleted anymore (Technically not a 3.0 regression, just 3.0 made the allocation smaller which is why the issue is only noticeable since 3.0)
During rejailbreak, /var/jb/basebin/gen/dyld.old corruption is now automatically detected and if found, the issue is automatically solved by moving the corrupted file to /private/preboot//orphaned-, which will allow rejailbreaking to work again

Fix "Finalizing Bootstrap" sometimes failing with "code signature invalid" error when jailbreaking a device for the first time [3.0.5 regression]
DISCLAIMER: Dopamine 3.0 - 3.0.6 have had a bug where during jailbreak environment updates, a kernel panic could occur that could leave /var/jb/basebin/gen/dyld.old in a corrupted state where it could not be deleted anymore, as a result of this, I do not recommend using this version span and rather recommend using 3.0.7 or higher instead. If you are affected by this issue, jailbreaking with 3.0.7 will automatically resolve this issue.

Actually fix random panics on TXM devices when something tries to load a dynamic trustcache (#893)
Actually enable support for iOS 26.1 beta 1 - 3 (A12/A13)
Fix possible panics after using the the "Respring" and "Reboot Userspace" buttons in the Dopamine app on iOS >=17
Properly disable jailbreak button when the device is jailbroken with Dopamine <=2.x or when it was jailbroken with a Dopamine app that had a different app id then the one currently running

Fix missing post exploitation clean up if the jailbreak failed or is being removed
DISCLAIMER: Dopamine 3.0 - 3.0.6 have had a bug where during jailbreak environment updates, a kernel panic could occur that could leave /var/jb/basebin/gen/dyld.old in a corrupted state where it could not be deleted anymore, as a result of this, I do not recommend using this version span and rather recommend using 3.0.7 or higher instead. If you are affected by this issue, jailbreaking with 3.0.7 will automatically resolve this issue.

Fix support for iOS 18.2 to 18.(?) [3.0.2 regression]
DISCLAIMER: Dopamine 3.0 - 3.0.6 have had a bug where during jailbreak environment updates, a kernel panic could occur that could leave /var/jb/basebin/gen/dyld.old in a corrupted state where it could not be deleted anymore, as a result of this, I do not recommend using this version span and rather recommend using 3.0.7 or higher instead. If you are affected by this issue, jailbreaking with 3.0.7 will automatically resolve this issue.

Fix random panics on TXM devices when something tries to load a dynamic trustcache
Fix non CS_ADHOC libraries not being loadable on TXM devices in certain processes for which fcntl(F_ADDSIGS, ...) is blocked by sandbox (Fixes some tweaks not working)
Fix binaries and libraries signed with a team id not working on TXM devices
Fix crashes with some apps that were installed by TrollStore Lite on iOS 17.0 - 17.3.1

Fix Titan not working on ARM_LARGE_MEMORY kernels (Mainly M1/M2 iPads)
Fix XPF being broken on some iOS 15.x versions
Fix kfd exploits being broken on iOS 16.x
Fix ClearSword / DarkSword showing up as supported even on devices that do not support them

Add Titan PPL/SPTM bypass by @alfiecg24, introduces support for all devices running 16.5.1 - 17.3.1
Add momentarius PPL bypass by @staturnzz and @TheRealClarity, introduces support for A12/A13 devices running 16.6 - 18.7.1, 26.0 - 26.0.1
Add support for SPTM devices up to 27.0 betas in general, can be tested on Corellium devices using the install script at Standalone/Corellium, obviously only works up to 17.3.1 on real devices due to lack of an SPTM bypass on >=17.4
Add ClearSword exploit by @TheRealClarity, cleaner alternative to DarkSword that seems to have better reliability

Fix support for iOS 17.1 - 17.3.1
Known issues
DarkSword currently does not support 2GB RAM devices running iOS 17.0 or higher (e.g. iPad 6)
Zebra crashes on launch on some newer iOS versions due to a missing entitlement, this will be fixed soon

Add support for iOS 16.7.16, 17.0 - 18.7.1 (arm64)
Fix a logic bug in forkfix [2.4.8 regression]
This build contains a lot of changes that will affect 15.0 - 16.7.15 too, so there needs to be extensive testing on those versions too so I can be sure there aren't any regressions
Known issues
Fix a logic bug in forkfix [2.4.8 regression]

Experimental fixes / improvements to DarkSword (contributed by @TheRealClarity)
For additional notes, check out the description of 2.5 Beta 1

Add DarkSword kernel exploit as an option
Adds support for iOS 15.8.7 (A9-A10) and iOS 16.7 - 16.7.15 (arm64)
Known issues:
DarkSword currently doesn't support A8(X)

Reflect that landa got patched in 15.8.7 (RIP) (Thanks @TheMasterOfMike for the PR)
Fix support for early iOS 16.1 betas
Minor fixes / improvements to forkfix

Fix an issue where the jailbreaking process would get stuck on "Patchfinding" on some device / version combinations (seemingly affected early iOS 15 arm64 devices the most) [2.4.6 regression]
Fix issues with custom boot logos not getting set / not persisting correctly
Fix an issue where selecting a picture taken with a camera as the custom boot logo would cause it to have the wrong orientation in some cases

Add the ability to have the device display a boot logo during userspace reboots (By default the background of the selected theme will be used, additionally there is an option to select a custom one)
Fix the issue that previously broke iOS 15 arm64 support when compiling libjailbreak with compiler optimizations, enable compiler optimizations for libjailbreak again
Fix a page table alignment bug in pmap_map_in that would never be triggered in practice unless a developer called it themselves with addresses not aligned to L2 boundaries
Several optimizations have been made to make rejailbreaking / userspace rebooting slightly faster
Revert compiler optimizations for libjailbreak since this broke 15.x arm64 support [2.4.4 regression]

Improve fix from 2.4.3 to also work in processes for which tweak injection has been disabled
Fix in-app respring button not working when jailbreak is hidden
Improve error message that appears when libgrabkernel2 does not work
Add password authentication for when changing mobile password (Contributed by @khcrysalis)
Fix an issue where calling dlopen in a fork child would fail (on iOS 15) or crash the process (on iOS 16) (Fixes perl crashing when running apt-file search  on iOS 16) [2.4 regression]

Extend library validation bypass to also work when something manually invokes fcntl in the dyld_shared_cache
Remove stray macho magics from patched dyld, works around issues where third party software (e.g. Frida) would mistake the wrong page to be the start of dyld, causing it to fail in unpredictable ways (Regarding Frida, there is still an issue where it conflicts with the spinlock panic fix, but I don't think there is anything I can do on Dopamines end to fix it, the issue is being tracked here) (Credits to @tihmstar for helping with debugging)
Update bootstrap tarball (Better late than never?)
Fix support for iOS 16.0.x [2.4 regression]

NOTE: Doing an OTA update to this version will reboot your device, requiring a rejailbreak afterwards, this is expected and unavoidable, because Dopamine <=2.3 has a bind mount that cannot possibly be unmounted without panicing the device.
Add a workaround for spinlock panics on iOS 15 arm64e that fully prevents them in all cases (except one, see below*)
Make "Hide Jailbreak" fully hide the jailbreak, to the point where it should be undetectable (see notes below)
Apply sandbox patches before linking, fixes issues when a process directly links against a library inside /var/jb

Stop redirecting all execve calls to posix_spawn, fixes issues with certain sandbox profiles (e.g. configd) that block posix_spawn but allow execve, fixes WPA2/3 ENTERPRISE networks not working (these issues started in 2.2 but were not a regression, in earlier versions the exec call was not hooked properly which is why this wasn't noticed before)

Bump default jetsam multiplier back to 3x because apparently people don't read changelogs and that's why we can't have nice things (Most people should still be using 2x, but that's on their own to figure out now...)

Remove DYLD_INTERPOSE in favor of other hooking techniques, since DYLD_INTERPOSE was apparently causing memory usage to be much higher than what it should be
The jetsam multiplier can now be configured inside the Dopamine app, in previous Dopamine versions this was 3x everywhere with no option to configure it, due to the removal of the DYLD_INTERPOSE, the default setting has been able to be lowered to 2x
NSTask is now supported everywhere by default, unlike before where it was only supported inside tweak dylibs or when you called dopamine_fix_NSTask yourself
Due to the better hooking techniques, a lot of unnecessary code has been able to be removed

Remove libkrw0 dependency of libkrw plug-in, should fix rejailbreaking when libkrw0 has been uninstalled
Improve verbose logging, also log stderr to it

Fix jailbreaking with developer mode disabled not working on iOS 16.0 - 16.3.1 arm64
Fix weightBufs not working on some device / version combinations
Fix libkrw physrw not working when kcall is not available
Improve libkrw packaging and error handling

Allow binaries to get custom pmap_cs trust level via the jb.pmap_cs_custom_trust entitlement, possible values: {"PMAP_CS_PROFILE_PREFLIGHT", "PMAP_CS_COMPILATION_SERVICE", "PMAP_CS_OOP_JIT" (iOS 16 only), "PMAP_CS_LOCAL_SIGNING", "PMAP_CS_PROFILE_VALIDATED", "PMAP_CS_APP_STORE", "PMAP_CS_IN_LOADED_TRUST_CACHE", "PMAP_CS_IN_STATIC_TRUST_CACHE"}, a lower trust level allows the process to be less restricted by PMAP_CS, this in practice fixes the EQE app and it's Lua recompiler not to work (but only if it has the entitlement, so make sure you use the newest EQE build)
Fix posix_spawnattr_setarchpref_np not being supported by the codesign bypass (#573)

Only automatically fix up permissions of relevant directories inside /var/jb/var/mobile, rather than the entirety of it
Skip permission fix up if either /var/jb/var or /var/jb/var/mobile is a symbolic link, previously there was a bootloop risk when either of them point to the real /var or /var/mobile

Fix app switcher not displaying preview images of jailbreak apps in some cases [2.1 regression]
Sandbox: Allow writing to /var/jb/var/mobile system wide

Fix codesigning bypass failing on binaries/libraries that have an armv7s slice (Fixes Designer not working) [2.1 regression]
Fix sharing files to jailbreak apps not working in some instances [2.1 regression]
Fix string corruption in sandbox bypass, the fact I never noticed this before means it probably wasn't that bad of an issue (don't use strcat on uninitialized stack buffers!)

Add support for A8(X) devices
Fix Dopamine app instantly crashing when installed using TrollStore on A8 devices
Add kcall implementation on arm64 iOS 15.x (this was needed for A8 support)
Use kcall for allocating page tables when available

Actually fix relevant file path permissions when rejailbreaking (previously the method for this existed but was never called, sigh...), this should now actually automatically fix issues such as NewTerm / SSH not working

Fix jailbreaking not working when developer mode was disabled (Developer mode will now be automatically enabled in a non persistent way for the current boot)
Fix NECP connections failing after some time on arm64 (Apple Watch, VPN...)
Fix terminusd crashes on arm64, reenable injection into it and nesessionmanager
Automatically fix wrong permissions for /private and /private/preboot when jailbreaking

Fix a super bad security issue where app store apps would be allowed to obtain full system captabilities (root + phys r/w) that were otherwise only intended to be accessible by root processes, as a result of this Dopamine 2.0.0 - 2.0.8 have been pulled and are no longer recommended to be used by anyone
Fix an issue where the arm64 related fixes of 2.0.7 and 2.0.8 were only working when ellekit was installed and tweak injection was enabled
Disable injection into terminusd and nesessionmanager on arm64 in an attempt to resolve issues with crash loops and VPN apps still not working for some users
Immediately allow invalid pages on all processes that are spawned via POSIX_SPAWN_START_SUSPENDED, this fixes an issue

Fix "Invalid kernel stack pointer" random panic
Apply forkfix for forks coming out of the daemon() and forkpty() functions
Fix a bug in the codesign bypass where the wrong slice could get trustcached in some rare circumstances, causing the binary to fail to spawn
Fix a minor inaccuracy in the execve systemwide hook

Fix an issue where on some devices launchd would get killed by jetsam during the initial userspace reboot, resulting in a kernel panic (1.1.3 regression)
Fix an issue where under some super rare circumstances some incorrect code path could invoke the functionality of the "Hide Jailbreak" button without it being pressed
Fix a miniscule and rare memory leak
KFDopamine-BETA.tipa:

Fix a bug where jailbreakd would crash while parsing a malformed MachO with an empty dependency path, this issue also prevented rejailbreaking if such a file existed somwhere inside /var/jb
Also parse LC_LAZY_LOAD_DYLIB and LC_LOAD_UPWARD_DYLIB when scanning for dependencies to add to TrustCache
Make execvp and execvP function reimplementations behave more closely to their stock implementations
KFDopamine-BETA.tipa:

Fix issues with trustcaching machos that have both old and new ABI arm64e slices
Fix several bugs in system wide exec(cve/cle/lp/v/vp/vP) hooks, which could cause arguments and environment variables to become malformed
Fix a path finding bug in execvP hook
Add missing execl hook
Add a workaround that makes spinlock timeout panics less likely, thanks to @RootHide
Update the bundled packages of Sileo and Zebra to their latest versions

Minor PPLRW improvements (better address translation, prevent process crashes when passing an invalid physical address)
Remove some leftover debug logs in launchdhook from during the 1.1.3 development phase

Fix unreliability when jailbreaking on A14 (1.1.3 regression)
Make forkfix only load when absolutely neccessary rather than inside every single process that is able to fork (This should decrease  spinlock panic frequency back to how it was on pre-1.1, but tweaks with C function hooks will obviously still cause it)

NOTE: When OTA updating to this release your device will reboot, unlike other releases where it would do a userspace reboot, this is expected, you will have to rejailbreak manually afterwards
Transition away from old PPLRW method to a new PPLRW method that works by mapping in the entire kernel physical address space into the userland process, this fixes all remaining issues with PPLRW such as multithreading support and TLB issues (unfortunately this is also what breaks jbupdate'ing with just a userspace reboot, as the primitives from earlier versions cannot easily be transferred to this one)
Reenable launchd crash reporter in a way that cannot be detected by apps
Hide uninstall jailbreak button when jailbroken

Disable launchd crash reporter again, as this triggered a lot of jailbreak detections (No idea how they detect this or what specifically they check for :/)
Disable jailbreak button when the device / version combination is unsupported

Add crash reporter for launchd crash reports, when launchd crashes now you will receieve a detailed separate crash log, alongside the (incredibly cryptic) "initproc exited" panic
Fix several wrong offsets related to the ptrace hook
Fix bug in macho parser where it would fail when parsing the dependencies from certain libraries
Improve wifi reenable reliability

Improve PPLRW performance by a factor of ~1000x
Fix all remaining forkfix issues, now works completely reliable, fork is also way faster now thanks to the PPLRW improvements mentioned above
Fix some race conditions with kcall and PPLRW
Add a watchdogd hook that intercepts userspace panics due to watchdog timeouts and instead disables tweak injection and triggers a userspace reboot (demo video:

Fix an issue with forkfix where it would break reinstalling dpkg
Automatically fix the permissions of /private/preboot/ when jailbreaking in case they are wrong (Wrong permissions can cause SSH / NewTerm to not work)

This listing uses the standard build. The developer publishes a separate build for yellow iPhone 14 and 14 Plus models on iOS 16.3.

versions.localizedDescription:
Update for Xcode 15.4+ compilation (fixes #25)

Removing confusing logging around exploit deinitialisation (e.g. #11)
Fix arm64e devices on iOS 15.7.x that couldn't download the kernelcache by updating libgrabkernel2 (should, in theory, fix #21)

Full support for iOS 17.0 beta 1 - 4 on arm64 devices - partially contributed to by @m1zole
Note: arm64e support for the above versions is still being worked on.

Add success message at the end of the installation
Fix bug in supported version checking
Add (untested) support for early iOS 17.0 betas

apps.name: lara
apps.localizedDescription: An on-device iOS customization toolbox with MobileGestalt editing, SpringBoard settings, and system appearance controls. Available features depend on the device, firmware, and release.

versions.localizedDescription:
Moved tweaks into its own accessible section, and put Tools there at the bottom.
Moved logs out of the tab bar and into a toolbar item at the top of the primary views (you can change this back in settings).
Settings has been completed reorganized, with some new customization toggles for the app itself.
Fixed kernelcache weirdness (kernelcache is now fetched locally)

this is the first proper release of lara. lara will be undergoing some major frontend and backend changes in the coming days and weeks, so expect things to move around, change, and function better. this build has a lot of issues currently, such as remotecall being super broken. if you are experiencing issues, it's recommended to wait rather than to open an issue or ask for support. if you are a contributor, it is highly recommended to not contribute anything until the rewrite is complete.

apps.name: AppStore++
apps.localizedDescription: CokePokes’ standalone App Store utility for TrollStore. It lets you browse available versions of an app and request an upgrade or downgrade when Apple still serves that build.

versions.localizedDescription:
Added a delete all/trashcan button for ipa library
Fixed bug when an ipa download is cancelled when packaging & becoming corrupted
Run ipa packaging on background thread so the UI isn't lagged

Added a new split-view layout for Installed Apps, AppStore Search, the IPA Library, and app-data backups.
Added dedicated detail pages with app information and relevant actions while keeping the selected app list visible.
Improved iPad spacing, icons, placeholders, section navigation, and AppStore-style presentation.
Added Chinese translations for the new iPad interface.

Added compatible and incompatible labels to available versions based on the device’s installed iOS version.
Added minimum iOS information to cached version details while retaining incompatible versions in the list.
Improved recovery of missing version dates and compatibility information without requiring the entire cache to be deleted.
Improved progress reporting while checking versions that Apple cannot return for the current device.

Added release-note information buttons beside available app versions.
Added a clean release-notes viewer with version and release-date information.
Expanded release-note coverage across older App Store and iTunes Store histories, including versions no longer shown in Apple’s current version history.
Added automatic recovery of missing version dates without requiring users to clear and download their entire version cache again.

Added pie progress for installation.
Fixed an issue restoring keychain data for backed up apps. (May need to redo your backups for compatibility.)
App is now killed after 5 minutes of inactivity.
Installed app list is now refreshed after installing an ipa.

Added a dedicated Updates tab for installed App Store apps.
Added an update-count badge that is populated when AppStore++ launches.
Updates are sorted by release date and display the release notes, date, version, download size, and app icon provided by Apple.
Every update includes an expandable App Store-style more button.

AppStore++ can now use the Apple Account already signed into the device for silent version lookups and account-authorized IPA downloads.
Most account-based features no longer require a separate Apple Account login inside AppStore++.
The separate AppStore++ login is now marked as deprecated.
Added a setting to disable use of the saved AppStore++ login without deleting the saved session.
Fixed some of the OPEN buttons not working correctly

This is one of the largest AppStore++ updates yet, bringing major improvements to version management, account integration, downloads, backups, and the overall interface.
Added a redesigned App Store-style search interface.
Search results now include app icons, screenshots, developer information, categories, ratings, and compatibility details.
Added full app-detail pages with:

-- Fixed issue with changing store region
-- Added AppStore descriptions, screenshots and reviews
-- Added ability to download apps no longer available on AppStore/not on device
-- Fixed an issue with 2FA when logging in Settings. Remember you can always put that 2FA code in on your next sign in, directly after the password (no space.)

-- Ability to buy apps you do not own (for instance if you cannot buy because the app was updated to an incompatible version before trying to purchase)
-- Page indicator to show app has more than one page
-- Ability to sign into your Apple account to parse versions faster and without the spam Download Compatible version prompts.
Total overhaul.
Changes: Ability to download AppStore++ updates to install in TrollStore

apps.name: Taurine
apps.localizedDescription: The Odyssey Team’s semi-untethered jailbreak for compatible iOS and iPadOS 14 devices. It ships with Sileo and uses libhooker for tweak loading. Supported firmware varies by device.

versions.localizedDescription: Fix kfd change being implemented incorrectly
Fix A11 14.0 - 14.4.x failing with kfd

The long awaited release of Taurine for iOS 14.8.1 is here, now you can jailbreak all of your devices from 14.0 up to 14.8.1!
This update includes a patch to allow Old ABI tweaks to work on iOS 14.5 (and its enabled by default) so everything should just work!

Introduce support for 14.4 to 14.8.1 for A10(X) and lower
Introduce support for iOS 14.5 to 14.8.1 on A11

Backports DER entitlement fixes from Taurine15
Backports codesignature fixes from Taurine15
Backports various other fixes from Taurine15
Fixed arm64e on 14.2 and 14.3

Adds support for taurine-permanent (should work now on first try)
Backports Swift patchfinder from \
Backports IMG4 parser from \ (removes img4tool and fixes Windows Defender false positive)
Adds support for iOS 15 DER entitlements to jailbreakd

Runs uicache for Sileo for first time users
Updates built-in libhooker to 1.6.9
Adds support for custom dyld shared caches

Update Sileo to 2.3
Replace Packix with Havoc as default repo
Add stability Improvement from Odyssey 1.4.1

Fixes issues with injection into cfprefsd
Re-enables tweak injection into cfprefsd
Reduces memory usage and improves performance system-wide

Adds a patch to fix the boot loop issue in stock iOS (the /var corruption that previously would require users to wait for the next BSOD to use startup repair)
Adds battery level indicator to recovery UI
Increases AMFI timeout so there's less BSODs on older/slower devices
Adds support for custom in-app themes

Includes new recovery utilities, including Startup Repair
Startup Repair will fix any bootloop issues caused by a file being corrupted during userspace reboot
Recovery menu can be manually activated by adding /.libhooker_recovery and then initiated via a userspace reboot

Fixes BSOD looping issues on devices with 2 GB RAM (e.g. A9 or A10)
Fixes memory spiking issues when loading certain large apps (now only uses 20 KB of RAM whereas 1.0.5 RC could spike temporarily up to ~400 - 500 MB depending on the size of the app)
Improves performance and reliability in low memory situations
NOTE: Use with Libhooker 1.6.2 or newer for best results.

Applies a fix for amfid panics so that it should happen less often
BSODs dump info about the BSOD to /.last_bsod
Creating /.verbose_bsod will show a verbose BSOD instead
SpringBoard alert when tweaks are disabled (either in case of a BSOD or when they're disabled manually)

Improves battery life
Fixes hangs when renaming certain tweak dylibs
Fixes userspace reboot failing for certain users
Fixes full system hangs for certain users

Fixes CarPlay on Ford vehicles (or the FordPass app) crashing
Fixes the shell failing to spawn sometimes (e.g. when spamming open tab in NewTerm)
Fixes kernel panics on malformed shell commands
Updates bundled bootstrap

Increase jetsam limits
Fix battery drain bug from 1.0.1
Redesigned userspace reboot screens!

Fix sandbox issues with certain processes (e.g. WebContent)
Fix zombie processes on subsequent userspace reboot
Initial Taurine Release!

apps.name: unc0ver
apps.localizedDescription: Pwn20wnd’s semi-untethered jailbreak for selected iOS 11 through iOS 14 releases. Compatibility depends on the exact version and device, and changed across releases.

versions.localizedDescription:
Add exploit guidance to improve reliability on A12-A13 iPhones running iOS 14.6-14.8

CarPlay without Siri in the queue: it no longer stays pending forever. Adding the package now goes through the queue once like any other: with a car connected it also lifts the Siri lock-out, otherwise it is simply turned on. The Control Center button, the Short

CarPlay without Siri, and the results of a full review of the app: safer writes, fewer crashes, and a lot of small things that now do what they say.
CarPlay without Siri (package, off until you turn it on): since iOS 18, CarPlay shows "CarPlay Not Available — To use CarPlay, enable Siri" while Siri is off. This lifts that screen, and Siri stays off. It is applied per connection: with the CarPlay Control Center button (iOS 18), the CarPlay without Siri Shortcuts action, a cyanide://carplay link, or Run while the car is connected. For hands-free use, create a Shortcuts automation CarPlay → Connects → Run Immediately with that action. It needs kernel access from an earlier Run.

Performance HUD: Apple's frame-rate and GPU overlay, in ten modes (Basic, Full, Power, GPU Time and more).

Apps in use are skipped and re-checked right before each one is cleaned; built-in apps are not selected by default.

System Info. Device and iOS details, uptime, kernel-access status, battery health and storage per app, with icons and sorting.
Reboot. A Reboot button next to Respring in Quick Actions. It stops live tweaks first, then asks iOS to restart.

Read-only root access (through launchd) is a separate option, also off by default. Every save keeps a backup, and a save that couldn't finish is reported instead of leaving a half-written file. You can share files up to 64 MB.
No write access as root, on purpose. Root access is read-only. This isn't a technical limit: writing to system files as root is one of the easiest ways to leave a device unable to boot, so Cyanide doesn't offer it.
Location Services toggle for Control

See what Apply is doing. The progress screen now shows the current step instead of only a spinner, for example "Resizing icons: page 3 of 7".
Auto-retry failed runs. New in Settings → Launch Options: when the exploit misses,

CPU % now works on every launch. Before, the CPU column was often blank or stuck at 0.0%, and some processes never got a value. Now every process gets a reading.
CPU % is accurate. Busy background services (Spotlight indexing, mail and others, especially while charging) now show their real load instead of almost nothing. 100% means one full core, so a busy multi-threaded process can go above 100%, up to 600% on a 6-core chip. The rows add up to the "CPU: X% busy

Polish and stability for the Process Viewer.

The large title no longer shrinks and re-centers when you open the viewer.
The list no longer jumps down when the process count appears.

Process Viewer (Settings → Process Viewer). A live process list, à la CocoaTop:
Every running process with CPU and memory, live-refreshing.
A count of active vs suspended processes at the top.

Passcode Style. Replaces the Lock Screen keypad digits with artwork you
import or build. Every write is read back and verified, the stock digits are

The shared view-hierarchy walk now runs on SpringBoard's main thread, so it no longer races SpringBoard's own layout.
The RemoteCall return-trap is now always waited for instead of being abandoned on a timeout, so a briefly suspended app can no longer leave SpringBoard in a state that crashes moments later.

Run recovers in milliseconds instead of re-running the exploit. Across the

A18 / M4 memory shaping stays on the proven fixed size (the same as older
builds), which tested more reliable than sizing it to the device's free
memory. Sizing-to-free-memory and a "give up cleanly and ask for a retry"

Recovery no longer stays disabled after a reboot. If you turned off

exist on that version. It now targets the right ones. Verified on iPhone 15

apps.name: SideInstaller
apps.localizedDescription: FrizzleM’s on-device installer for SideStore on supported iOS 27 builds. Supported firmware and installation behavior vary by release.

versions.localizedDescription:
lillq is the first anisette server. anisette.lillq.me, a pool of anisette servers that checks every hour which clients Apple lets through, is now on the list in Settings › Anisette Server, and a first sign-in starts there. With Auto on, it comes right after the server that signed in last and the others that share its anisette identity, which keep the saved sign-in.
Signing in to Apple works again. Since 20 November Apple has answered sign-ins through every Mac anisette server with HTTP 503 (#146–#161), turning away any client that calls its system “macOS”. SideInstaller now signs in as a Mac on macOS 10.15.7, the newest that still calls itself “Mac OS X”, which Apple lets through and which is new enough for the

Pick the developer team that signs. An Apple Account on more than one developer team (a paid Apple Developer Program membership or a company's team, besides the free one every account has) is asked once which team signs, each marked Free or Paid. The question starts on the team that signed SideInstaller itself, so a copy siboot installed with another team now refreshes itself in place. The pick is remembered for the Apple ID and used for installs, refreshes, Certificates and Entitlements; swipe the Apple ID in Settings › Account and tap Team to pick again.

Blue is back. The greys from 2.0.0 are blues again: night-blue pages, cards and popups under a still navy wash at the top, a solid blue main button, and a lighter blue for progress, links, selections and switches. The app icon and the logo tiles have their colour back, in a brighter blue than before 2.0.0. The Live Activities and sideinstaller.net match.

The reason why I have chosen v2.0.0 for this release is because of the huge change in the way SideInstaller is now installed. Enterprise certs are no longer needed as I have developed a method that is no longer subject to blacklists. Full info is at
AltStore. AltStore Classic is on the Install tab and in Side by Side, from AltStore's own source, with the download checked against the SHA-256 it lists. Its pairing file goes where AltStore reads it, so setting up Remote AltServer skips pairing.
A quieter look. A still, near-black background with plain cards and an off-white main button. Blue marks only progress, selections and links. The pairing code shows one key per digit, on the Lock Screen too, and nothing pul

Turkish. Pick Türkçe in Settings › Language. Thanks to Mr3242-Scripter (#111).
A nudge to update to iOS 27 at setup on devices that can run it: on iOS 27 the iPhone pairs with itself, no computer needed.
Side by Side goes step by step and can now install SideStore and LiveContainer + SideStore too (Stable or Nightly), each set up with the pairing file on the other iPhone.
Your Apple ID session and pairing stay on this iPhone: private files are left out of backups, and the saved password is kept in the Keychain for this device only. After restoring a backup, sign in and pair again.

Madeira is now fetched from its main repo, with stable and nightly releases being given as a choice to the user
An imported SideStore, LiveContainer + SideStore or Madeira .ipa is now set up just like the download, including SideStore's pairing file and certificate (#108). Where GitHub can't be reached, as in mainland China, a card explains how to bring the .ipa this way.
Apps with an ExtensionKit extension (in Extensions rather than PlugIns) install instead of failing with “Mismatched bundle IDs”: those extensions now get the app's new bundle ID, its provisioning profile and their own signature (#110).
Apps with data after a binary's signature, such as IPAs taken from a TrollStore install, can be signed instea

Inside LiveContainer, “Use SideStore's certificate” now works (#95). SideStore's reply can't reach SideInstaller there, so SideInstaller takes the certificate LiveContainer holds instead (its built-in SideStore's, or the copy LiveContainer imported) and checks it against your Apple ID as before.
Inside LiveContainer, “Get it from SideStore” now imports the pairing file LiveContainer's built-in SideStore keeps, asking first, instead of opening SideStore for a reply that never came. In Multitask Mode, or when there's no file to take, it says what to do instead.

With a pairing file made on a computer, “Open the device link” no longer stops with “peer closed connection without sending TLS close_notify” before iOS 26.4 (#105, #107). SideInstaller now answers the iPhone’s heartbeat while the link is open, as SideStore and StikDebug do.

Custom .ipas now get automatically signed with Extended Memory Limit
Downloads now get paused instead of cancelled, so users can resume at anytime
Sound effects, which can be disabled with silent mode or on the app’s settings
Bug reports now attach the full log to GitHub

Fixed Apple ID sign-in failing with error -80046 ("This action cannot be completed at this time") after entering the verification code
SideInstaller now signs in through Mac anisette servers, starting with "SideStore (New)", and reports a current Mac through them, the fix SideStore users found
The first sign-in makes a new anisette identity, so Apple asks for your verification code once more
With Auto, the Android anisette servers are no longer tried, since Apple refuses to finish signing in through them

Installs now keep going when you leave SideInstaller
On iOS 26 and later the install runs in the background: switch apps or lock your iPhone and it carries on, with its progress in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen, where you can also stop it
Below iOS 26, a Live Activity shows the progress for the ~30 seconds iOS allows, then says the install is paused and carries on once you open SideInstaller again
The Dynamic Island turns orange when the install needs you (2FA code, App ID confirmation, VPN or Wi-Fi, Trust prompt) and red with the reason if it fails

Strengthened the Anisette servers by adding new ones that use a Windows protocol. Also improved LocalDevVPN compatibility.
Switching between anisette servers no longer breaks sign-in. SideInstaller now keeps a separate anisette identity for each kind of server (Android, Windows, Mac). If a server goes down, sign-in can move to another kind without making a new identity and asking for your verification code again.
LocalDevVPN's auto launch now occurs only when it is needed, rather than on the app's launch.
New sign-ins start on a Windows anisette server ("jkcoxson (Windows ADI)"). If you have signed in before, SideInstaller stays on the server you used and keeps your saved sign-in. If that server fails, the Wind

Apple fixed the patch v1.5.0, so I switched the login device to Windows and it now works
Fixed the Apple ID login error
This is a temporary fix, and will likely be patched by Apple as well, just like the Android in v1.5. A permanent one is in the works.

Improved certain aspects of the Apple ID login
2FA with SMS and calls work again. They stopped working in v1.5.0 because requests are now sent from Android which doesn't support those methods, and to fix it, SideInstaller makes that request from a Mac and the rest is still done from an Android.
Added an error message for Apple accounts with unverified emails, with clear instructions on how to do so.

Fixed the urgent anisette error -80045
Please note, apps such as Sidestore and Livecontainer may still need to patch this error, so you may still get it on those apps. That doesn't depend on me
The app now uses glass for its buttons
Improved accessibility by making the ToS checkbox an actual checkbox

Added Madeira as an installable app
Madeira runs Windows PC games on your iPhone. It needs iOS 26 or later; on older versions SideInstaller tells you right away instead of using up an App ID
It's signed with the Increased Memory Limit entitlement it needs (Madeira shows it as Memory+)
Your pairing file is put inside Madeira, so "In-app with pairing file" is already done in its JIT setup. This works with the pairing SideInstaller makes on iOS 27, or an imported pairing file that has an RPPairing record

Added experimental support for installing Altstore using the "Custom .ipa" feature
Added support for "ALTDeviceID" for those who install Altstore using Custom .ipa
SideInstaller will auto-insert the pairing file into Altstore if installed using Custom.ipa
Fixed a bug caused by background task IDs (iLoader issue #649)

Switched app signing to apple-codesign-quick (the same signer iLoader uses)
Signing is about 6-9x faster
SideInstaller is about 5 MB smaller
Popups that appear together are now merged into one card

Fixed a bug in the installation of the latest nightly of SidesStore
The app would put the pairing file in the wrong path as it has been changed with an update. Issue has been fixed.
Improved visibility of popups

Closing certain popups will warn the user as it will end the process
Added an error for network issues
Removed certain personal data from logs to improve privacy

Messages are now shown as popups to improve clarity
Added advanced options to the install page
Users can now choose the Sidestore (+ Livecontainer) version
Users can now manually import the pairing file on iOS 27+ #60

Strongly optimized the install process
It can now be as short as 11.1s in ideal conditions
Fixed a bug in Side by Side #52

This is the biggest update SideInstaller has had so far. Enjoy v1, alongside iOS 27’s official release <3
Added a Tools page
Added “Side by Side”, which lets one iPhone/iPad wirelessly install SideInstaller on another iPhone/iPad
Certificates and Pairing are now in the Tools tab

Sorry for the instability these days. This update makes SideInstaller fully compatible with the latest releases of all apps, including SideStore Nightly.
SideStore, LiveContainer + SideStore and Feather now accept the pairing file SideInstaller puts in them, instead of asking you for one as though nothing had been placed.
SideInstaller now switches on the setting those apps need to reach your iPhone over your local tunnel, which nothing was doing before.
The install may ask you to unlock your iPhone and tap Trust once, and it remembers the result so it won't ask again for that device.

V1 is planned to be released by the time that Apple releases iSO 27’s official build. To ensure that, my goal currently is to bring a stable version of the app rather than introducing any new features. This update significantly brings us closer to that goal as it fixes the 2 most common and irritating errors reported so far. Please, keep testing it and share your issues on GitHub or on the discord server. <3
Fixed the SideStore nightly error “Domain=AltSign.Error Code=1 The app extension is missing a valid provisioning profile. UserInfo={NSLocalizedFailureReason =The app extension is missing a valid provisioning profile.}”
To fix it, the app now writes embedded.mobileprovision into each .appex before sign::sign

This update brings significant changes to the backend. The app is now more optimized with LocalDevVPN, which should cause much less issues with tunnel connections being refused or expired.
Users can now import any IPA from Files and SideInstaller signs and installs that instead of downloading.
Documents is now visible in Files › On My iPhone › SideInstaller. If you put a SideStore.ipa there, the install uses it. This can be useful for those who cannot access GitHub servers. #9
A failed download falls back to a copy from an earlier run.

Fixed urgent heartbeat bug
Improved translations
Fixed an urgent bug caused by translations
Added Spanish, Vietnamese, Italian, and French languages
Added a stable/nightly release selector
Fixed a bug with the check for updates

Fixed a few tab transitioning bugs
Moved the .ipa downloads to the app's settings
Added a welcome screen with the necessity to accept the TOS

Users can now extract their pairing file fully on device on SideInstaller. Once that is done, they can either export it as a raw file or insert it directly into the apps that can use it (StikDebug, Feather, Livecontainer, ect.)
New installable app: StikDebug
Fixed error "Developer error 8220: Your team has no devices from which to generate a provisioning profile."
App now checks for updates and notifies user when there is one
Added Discord, GitHub and Ko-Fi URLs to the settings page

App is now compatible with devices that do not have developer mode on
If the above condition is true, the app will autonomously register the account to Apple's developer program
This is done autonomously, no user interaction required

Fixed most bugs found in v0.1.0
Added "downloads" that lets the user delete the downloaded ipa files.
Beta phase. Will be unstable.

apps.name: LiveContainer
apps.localizedDescription: An iOS app container that runs supported apps inside a host app. This listing uses the standalone LiveContainer build. Upstream also publishes a combined SideStore build.

versions.localizedDescription:
Added a new storage management view with a breakdown of app bundles, containers, temporary files, app group data, tweaks, and other files. (Hidden apps' size is included in "other" section until unlocked)
Added per-app storage details, including app bundle size, container sizes, and last-used date.
Added actions to clean temporary files and caches, including guest app caches and LiveContainer's own caches.
Added configurable launch priority for multiple LiveContainer instances, making shared-app shortcuts choose available instances in the order you prefer. (#1367)

Fix an issue where built-in SideStore may freeze on launch (#1158)
Fix the ipa of another LiveContainer not generating in LiveContainer+SideStore builds after SideStore's massive codebase change (#1184)
Fix the new Launch App Shortcut does not work below iOS 18 (#1159)
The Launch App Shortcut now reports meaningful errors

Happy Spring Festival / Lunar New Year! After six months of development, we’re excited to release LiveContainer 3.7.0. This update introduces several powerful new features, including the Launch App Shortcut, iOS 26 JIT script support, external containers, native icon generation, and more.
A new extension allows apps to launch instantly without opening the LiveContainer main interface (for apps that are not locked, hidden, or JIT-required). Once configured, the shortcut prepares the runtime environment and selects an available LiveContainer instance to launch the app directly.
This reduces extra relaunches and jumps and typically saves 1~2 seconds per launch.
See the setup guide for instructions.

Fixed an issue where symbol offset caches were not reset after an iOS update, causing crashes. Fixes #765 #757 #760
Fixed a bug where window controls could appear behind the status bar if the app was terminated while in full-screen mode with the dock hidden. Fixes #742
Fixed an issue preventing the built-in SideStore from deactivating apps. Fixes #725
Fixed a problem where LiveContainer failed to locate certain symbols in dyld on iPad 7 running iOS 18.6. Fixes #746

This version of LiveContainer focuses on quality-of-life improvements, new features such as app sorting and enhanced multitasking, as well as various bug fixes.
LiveContainer/LiveContainer2 now has a new HD icon and supports dark and tinted modes. By @m1337v.
A dock has been added for multitasking mode. The dock can be hidden by dragging it to the edge of the screen, and collapsed by tapping the collapse button. You can also resize the dock in the settings. By @boa-z.
In windowed multitasking mode, you can now maximize or minimize windows using buttons on the new window bar. By @boa-z.

Fix #590: We adopted a new method for relaunching LiveContainer which makes apps launch faster compared to 3.5.0. by @khanhduytran0
Fix Liquid Glass option need to be toggled off and on in order to work. It's off by default now and you can toggle it on in iOS Settings -> Apps -> LiveContainer -> Enable Liquid Glass

After two months of development, we're proud to announce the release of LiveContainer 3.5.0! This update brings powerful new features like multitasking and better ADP certificate support, along with several bug fixes, improvements, and new language translations.
One of LiveContainer’s main limitations has been the inability to open more than one app at a time. Our new multitasking feature addresses that.
You can now launch multiple apps simultaneously in in-app virtual windows. These windows can be resized, scaled, and even displayed using the native Picture-in-Picture (PiP) feature. On iPads, apps can run in native window mode, displaying each app in a separate system window.
And if you wish, you can choose to

This version improved app re-signing experience, add support for new JIT enablers, increased compatibility with relatively old apps and add translation for Arabic, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese and Swedish.
LiveContainer has upgraded SDK version to 18.2, which breaks some apps that works on previous versions. Fortunately we have developed the "Spoof SDK Version" feature, forcing system libraries to operate in the SDK version the app is built with. You can enable "Spoof SDK Version".
Instead of keeping track of expiration date, LiveContainer now directly ask iOS to determine whether the code signature is valid, which significantly decreases app re-sign rate. For now your apps will be re-signed only if the

LiveContainer is now compatible with JitStreamer-EB 0.2.4. Now JIT acquisition happens after app launch, so LiveContainer will show an alert to tell you whether JIT is successfully acquired.
See 3.3.0 for more new features.

This update includes several compatibility and bug fixes, as well as new features such as JITStreamer-EB support and the ability to install from URLs and share sheets. Additionally, we have changed some confusing text.
Due to a change of LiveContainer's entitlement and a bug with SideStore/AltStore, SideStore 0.6.0+ / AltStore 2.0+ is required to install LiveContainer 3.3.0
You can now install apps directly from a URL by using the plus button on the "My Apps" page or by using an install URL like livecontainer://install?url=xxxxxxx. Additionally, you can share an IPA file directly from other apps via the share sheet. (Please note that iOS may hide LiveContainer in the "More" section—simply tap "More" and scroll

LiveContainer 3.3.0 is now in test. It includes features like JITStreamer-EB support, install from url and share sheet, personal cert support and bug fixes. Check #372 for more information.
This version focuses on compatibility issues, bug fixes, and QOL changes.
This update introduces a change in how settings are stored. Downgrading after updating will result in the loss of all app-specific settings. Please remember to reinstall the second LiveContainer to prevent data conflict.
Additionally, some apps may display a black screen and crash after 10 seconds in v3.2.0. Please refer to the "Black Screen Fix" section below for more details.

ZSign is now added as one of LiveContainer's signers.
ZSign has less format check comparing to AltSign, the signer used by SideStore/AltStore/LiveContainer, so it potentially signs apps then AltSign, solving issues like #222 and #134.
Its caching feature allows it to sign faster than AltSign.
AltSign remains the default signer for competibility reasons. You can switch signer in Settings and app-specific settings for one specific app.

LiveContainer now has a AltStore-like UI.
Main page is colorful now (#192) by @slds1
SideJITServer/JITStreamer 2.0 support
AltStore support

JIT-less setup may fail to find the signing certificate. This is worked around by re-adding the glob keychain group entitlement. (not guaranteed to work, as I couldn’t reproduce the issue in the first place)
Switches in settings not working. Apparently using the private Preference framework causing changes to be saved to the wrong preference file.
Some apps may get stuck on a black screen caused by an unknown deadlock. This is worked around by pre-initializing UIScreen.
Some apps may fail to create temporary files. This is fixed by redirecting guest app’s temporary directory to that of LiveContainer using symlink instead of creating its own. (thanks @hugeBlack for hinting me the issue)

A lot of users have been getting this issue, but I wasn’t able to find the root cause till now. After updating to 2.1.1, please Renew JIT-less certificate and then it will work.
Updated to 6fdcfe4 to address a regression.

I skipped 2.0 full release since this also introduces new features.
This was suggested by some people, and there was also a PR (#62, thanks @Vishram1123) trying to implement this as half app and half shortcuts.
I eventually implemented the entire functionality into LiveContainer.
Tweak injection has been there since early builds, but it wasn’t useful due to lack of user interface and JIT requirement. Now with support for JIT-less and a basic UI will make things more fun.

JIT-less mode allows you to run app inside LiveContainer without having to enable JIT, which is best suited for iOS 17 as enabling JIT on device is no longer possible.
It works by directly loading signed Mach-O from Documents directory which is only allowed if host app has get-task-allow entitlement.
App compatibility: some apps (Provenance) will not work yet; some tweaked apps (uYou+) will crash because of CydiaSubstrate.
Failed to find certificate issue may occur for some users.
Initial release.
